about: Ground truth by reading for the proof session's adversarial round, written by Claude AFTER the results were seen, independently of what the tool said. Fields as in planned-reading.json, plus 'falseRefusals': refusals judged not to be real disagreements (the code is right; the reader could not tell), with the count of refusal lines.

A01-stored-row-shape.note: reports reads bookings' rows from the store as 'anything'. Nothing in any listing describes those rows, so no listing changes.

A03-reexported-function.note: rooms' own test checks its ids against the old slug form (hyphens): it is right to be told, because the bound of the slug changed.

A04-message-kind-not-shared.note: billing kept its own copy of the message kind. Nothing checks that both running parts use the one shared kind.

A06-error-kind-changed.note: The listing has no place for the kinds of error a function raises (@throws is read as an explanation).

A07-bound-test-moved-line-not.note: bookings' test named 'bound party: whole number, 1 to 200' now tests 100. Nothing compares a bound test with the bound line it is named for.

A08-request-line-built-in-steps.note: One cause: the reader cannot read a request line built in two steps, so it calls the line plain text and then cannot type the answer; every later use of the answer is refused too. The code is right.

A09-assert-narrowing.note: One cause: Node's assert has no description the reader can use, so it cannot see that assert.equal(a.kind, 'reading') rules out the other kinds. The test is right.

A10-kind-split-same-shape.note: A defect of this tool, not of the method: when a kind is written as two kinds joined (&), the tool does not gather the bound lines of the parts, so every entry handing back a Booking appears to have lost its bounds.

A12-caught-error-makes-user-unfollowed.note: front's tests read e.message of a caught error. The tool counts that as reading a value of unknown kind and stops following front for every provider.

A14-copy-of-kind-in-the-middle.note: front fails only because bookings now passes on an Amount where its own comment promises a Price; bookings' check refuses exactly that line, so the cause is pointed at. front will be told when bookings' job changes Price.
